residual_risks: Shared-kernel and host-administrator residual risk: process restrictions or containers on a Windows desktop rely on the host kernel and local administrator TCB; a hostile or compromised host administrator, kernel, firmware, or trusted runtime can defeat the boundary (HYBRID_ISOLATION_PROFILES.md §2.1).

Shared-kernel or hypervisor and host-administrator residual risk: multi-tenant server isolation depends on the chosen host kernel/runtime or hypervisor and on server administrators; a compromised host kernel, hypervisor, firmware, or host administrator remains outside the claimed boundary (HYBRID_ISOLATION_PROFILES.md §2.1).

Shared-kernel and host-administrator residual risk: namespaces/containers share the host kernel and a local administrator can defeat desktop controls (HYBRID_ISOLATION_PROFILES.md §2.1); Linux file-based custody cannot claim protection against the host administrator, who can read or export file-based keys (HYBRID_RUNNER_TRUST_DESIGN.md §3.3).

Shared-kernel or hypervisor and host-administrator residual risk: multi-tenant Linux isolation depends on host kernel/runtime or hypervisor assumptions and server administrators (HYBRID_ISOLATION_PROFILES.md §2.1); Linux file-based custody cannot claim protection against the host administrator, who can read or export file-based keys (HYBRID_RUNNER_TRUST_DESIGN.md §3.3).

open_questions: どの隔離候補（W-D/W-S/L-D/L-S）を配備対象として選ぶか。
各候補に残る共有カーネル／ハイパーバイザ／ローカル管理者の残余リスク（L-D/L-S では HYBRID_RUNNER_TRUST_DESIGN.md §3.3 のファイル保管リスクを含む）を受諾するか。
HYBRID_ISOLATION_PROFILES.md §7 項目 4 にある独立検証者（実装・設定の作成者と分離）を誰に任命するか。
